G01.strict: Closed or nearly closed angular pointed outline facing screen-right AND discernible internal stroke configuration compatible with pilot. Shape break/unknown interior gives partial only.
G01.partial: Pointed outline without enough interior detail.
G01.do_not_merge: Rotation or mirror reversal not counted as strict identity.

G02.strict: Upright single stroke with ONE clear short branch to screen-right, distinct from cell borders.
G02.partial: Branch number or border attribution unclear.

G03.strict: Rounded closed outline with one roughly horizontal interior crossbar and no additional clear interior strokes.
G03.partial: Outline or bar incomplete, or bar rotated.

G04.strict: Rounded contour with complex angular interior as pilot; generic round outline insufficient.

G05.strict: Rounded contour with horizontal crossbar plus clear descending internal stroke.

G06.strict: Small oval outline with multiple short parallel internal strokes clearly separate from border.

layout_prediction.hypothesis: At least some records distinguish impressed-depression/short-stroke fields from complex marks in bounded regions. This is a spatial-functional hypothesis, not numerical or linguistic decoding.
layout_prediction.positive: At least two readable bounded regions on one heldout upper main view each show a deep depression next to a short parallel-stroke bundle and/or a distinct complex; relation repeats in the same region orientation.
layout_prediction.uncertain: Only one region or poor preservation; no forced negative.
layout_prediction.negative: Readable regions but no such repeated relation.
alternatives: Uniform running text with incidental spatial arrangement
Pictorial labels or mixed nonphonetic system; function unresolved

limits: No probability sample or independent random test; catalogue neighbours may be related.
Strict candidate is not proof of same sound/meaning or canonical sign.
Do not tune criteria after heldout inspection.
